import re
import sys

values = {}
assignment = re.compile(
    r"^\s*(a|b|c|d|TMP)\s*<-\s*(.*?)\s*;\s*$"
)
increment = re.compile(
    r"\(\s*(a|b|c|d|TMP)\s*\+\s*(\d+)\s*\)\s*mod\s*100"
)

for line in sys.stdin:
    match = assignment.fullmatch(line)
    if not match:
        continue

    name, expression = match.groups()
    expression = expression.strip()

    inc_match = increment.fullmatch(expression)
    if inc_match:
        variable, amount = inc_match.groups()
        values[name] = (values[variable] + int(amount)) % 100
    else:
        values[name] = int(expression)

print(
    f"a ?= {values['a']}; b ?= {values['b']}; c ?= {values['c']}; "
    f"d ?= {values['d']}; TMP ?= {values['TMP']};"
)
